title: Home-based Cognitive Strategy Training for Daily Living in Adults With Chronic Stroke
official: Feasibility of Home-based Cognitive Strategy Training for Independence of Activities of Daily Living in Adults With Chronic Stroke
summary: This pilot experimental study aims to describe the feasibility of a cognitive strategy training protocol : PRPP-I, in activities of daily life across home-based setting for adults with chronic stroke for improvement of independence and quality of life. Aditionnally to examine preliminary effectiveness of PRPP-I protocol within a home-based setting on functional cognitive strategies, independence, quality of life and career burden.

interventions.name: Perceive, Recall, Plan and Perform-Intervention protocol (PRPP-I)
